title: Record

primer.title: Record what’s happening
primer.body: Voisino needs the following to record:
primer.camera: Camera and microphone: only while this screen is open. Videos must be recorded in the app; importing from your gallery is not available.
primer.location: Location, when you publish: to show the video to nearby neighbors. Everyone sees an approximate location, rounded to about 50 m.
primer.privacy: Faces are automatically blurred before publication, but some may be missed. Avoid recording identifiable people and report concerning content. License plates are not blurred.

errors.denied: Camera or microphone access was denied. Allow it in this site’s browser settings, then try again.
errors.notFound: No camera is available on this device.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot record video. Try Safari on iOS or Chrome on Android.

switchFailed: Couldn’t open that camera, back to the previous one.
switchHint: Double-tap the picture to switch cameras

form.title: Publish
form.caption: Caption

captionGuide.alert: Say what is happening and where.
captionGuide.deal: Include the price or benefit and any conditions.
captionGuide.event: Say what, when, and where to meet.
captionGuide.help: Explain what kind of help you need.
captionGuide.lost: Describe the item and where you saw it.
captionGuide.shop: Describe the offer and its conditions.

captionPlaceholder.alert: E.g. Roadworks on …, traffic is slow near …
captionPlaceholder.deal: E.g. Lunch menu for €…, available until …
captionPlaceholder.event: E.g. Neighborhood fair Saturday at …, meet at …
captionPlaceholder.help: E.g. Looking for a hand with … near …
captionPlaceholder.lost: E.g. Tabby cat spotted near … around …

safety.title: Safety before publishing
safety.people: Film useful neighborhood facts, not people. Automatic face blur can miss some faces.
safety.plates: Avoid showing license plates or exact addresses if they could identify a person or place.
safety.emergency: If there is an immediate danger, call 112 first: Voisino is not an emergency service.

form.processing: Video sent! Blurring and processing are underway. It should appear shortly.

location.denied: Location access was denied. It is required to publish. Allow it in your browser settings.
location.imprecise: Location is too imprecise (±{accuracy} m; 100 m maximum). Move to an open area or wait a few seconds, then try again.
location.unavailable: Location is unavailable. Check that location services are on, then try again.

offline.queued: You’re offline. The video is saved on this device and will be sent automatically when you’re back online, if you’re still near where it was recorded.
offline.pending: {count, plural, one {# video waiting to upload} other {# videos waiting to upload}}
offline.sent: Your queued video has been published.
offline.retryable: Upload temporarily unavailable. The video is saved on this device.
offline.locationUnavailable: Location unavailable. The video is saved; check your location settings, then try again.
offline.waitPrecision: Location is too imprecise to publish. The video remains on this device; try again from an open area.
offline.droppedMoved: Video not published: you are no longer near where it was recorded.
offline.droppedStale: Video not published: it passed the 6-hour storage limit.
offline.failed: Publishing failed. The video was not saved; record a new one to try again.

errorsPublish.position_incoherent: Your location does not seem consistent with your last publication.
errorsPublish.upload_missing: The file did not finish uploading. Try again.
